class.name: InputPromptSet
class.brief_description: A game's own button prompt images, over Purr's.
class.description: Maps a control to an image: [code]"family/control"[/code], such as [code]"xbox/a"[/code], [code]"playstation5/left_trigger"[/code], [code]"keyboard/space"[/code] or [code]"mouse/left"[/code]. Families are [code]xbox[/code], [code]playstation4[/code], [code]playstation5[/code], [code]nintendo[/code], [code]steam_deck[/code], [code]keyboard[/code] and [code]mouse[/code]. A controller's controls are Godot's button names ([code]a[/code], [code]start[/code], [code]dpad_up[/code]), the sticks' directions ([code]left_stick_right[/code]), [code]left_trigger[/code] and [code]right_trigger[/code]; keys are Godot's key names in lower case ([code]space[/code], [code]kp_enter[/code]). Anything it leaves out shows Purr's own. Set it in Project Settings ([code]input_devices/prompts/custom_set[/code]).
